name: ES-CL Intraday Correlation: Pre-RTH vs RTH
description: Compares rolling 60-bar correlation between ES and CL 5-min returns across two sub-windows: Pre-RTH (8:00-9:30 ET) and RTH (9:30-11:30 ET). Tests whether the pre-open hour produces noisier (higher-variance) correlation readings than the main session. Outputs: dual-window correlation time series, variance comparison bar chart (Std Dev + IQR), and summary statistics table.
source:
# ES-CL Intraday Correlation: Pre-RTH vs RTH Variance Comparison
# Rolling 60-bar correlation of 5-min returns
# Pre-RTH = 8:00-9:30 ET, RTH = 9:30-11:30 ET
# Question: Is the pre-open hour noisier than the main session?

# --- Data: ES (primary) ---
es_raw = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
es_cont = futures_continuation(timeframe=5Min, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio)(es_raw.o, es_raw.h, es_raw.l, es_raw.c, es_raw.v, es_raw.oi, es_raw.s)

# --- Data: CL (reference) ---
cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl_cont = futures_continuation(timeframe=5Min, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)

# --- Two session windows ---
pre_rth = session_window(session=Session(start='08:00', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York'))(es_cont.o, es_cont.h, es_cont.l, es_cont.c)
rth = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York'))(es_cont.o, es_cont.h, es_cont.l, es_cont.c)

# --- Returns: 5-min bar-to-bar ---
es_ret = returns(period=1)(es_cont.c)
cl_ret = returns(period=1)(ffill(cl_cont.c))

# --- Rolling correlation (60-bar window) ---
corr_60 = rolling_corr(window=60)(es_ret, cl_ret)

# --- Filter correlation to each sub-window ---
# In-session: for the time series chart (dense within each window)
corr_pre_active = where(pre_rth.active, corr_60)
corr_rth_active = where(rth.active, corr_60)

# Session-end snapshots: one reading per day per window (sparse — for stats)
corr_pre_eod = where(pre_rth.closed, corr_60)
corr_rth_eod = where(rth.closed, corr_60)

# --- Variance metrics via cumulative (expanding window over session-end readings) ---
# Std Dev
std_pre = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(corr_pre_eod)
std_rth = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(corr_rth_eod)

# IQR = Q75 - Q25
q75_pre = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.75)(corr_pre_eod)
q25_pre = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.25)(corr_pre_eod)
iqr_pre = q75_pre - q25_pre

q75_rth = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.75)(corr_rth_eod)
q25_rth = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.25)(corr_rth_eod)
iqr_rth = q75_rth - q25_rth

# --- Decorrelation events: session-end correlation below -0.5 in either window ---
is_decorr_pre = is_valid(corr_pre_eod) and corr_pre_eod < -0.5
is_decorr_rth = is_valid(corr_rth_eod) and corr_rth_eod < -0.5

# Window label for event marker badge
decorr_window = conditional_select(is_decorr_pre, 'Pre-RTH', is_decorr_rth, 'RTH', 'None')
decorr_corr = conditional_select(is_decorr_pre, corr_pre_eod, is_decorr_rth, corr_rth_eod, 0.0)
is_any_decorr = is_decorr_pre or is_decorr_rth

# --- Timestamps ---
ts = index()

# --- Output 1: Correlation time series — both windows overlaid ---
xy_lines(
    title='Pre-RTH vs RTH: ES-CL Rolling Correlation',
    category='Pre-RTH vs RTH Correlation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Pre-RTH (8:00-9:30)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='RTH (9:30-11:30)', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Decorrelation')
    ]),
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(corr_pre_active, corr_rth_active))

# --- Output 2: Variance comparison bar chart (punchline) ---
# Series mode with stacks: Pre-RTH vs RTH grouped, Std Dev + IQR as bars
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Is Pre-RTH Noisier? Std Dev & IQR of Session-End Correlation',
    category='Pre-RTH vs RTH Correlation',
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Dispersion',
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Std Dev', color=Color.Blue, stack='Pre-RTH'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='IQR', color=Color.Sky, stack='Pre-RTH'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Std Dev', color=Color.Slate, stack='RTH'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='IQR', color=Color.Gray, stack='RTH')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(std_pre, iqr_pre, std_rth, iqr_rth))

# --- Output 3: Summary stats table — side-by-side comparison ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Session-End Correlation: Pre-RTH vs RTH',
        row_size=5, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Obs Count', 'Median', 'Std Dev', 'Min', 'Max'],
        col_headers=['Pre-RTH', 'RTH'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Session-end observations (Pre-RTH)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Session-end observations (RTH)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Median session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Median session-end correlation'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Std dev — higher = noisier'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Std dev — higher = noisier'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Most negative reading'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Most negative reading'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Most positive reading'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, info='Most positive reading')
        ]
    ),
    category='Pre-RTH vs RTH Correlation',
    order=3
)(corr_pre_eod, corr_rth_eod, corr_pre_eod, corr_rth_eod, corr_pre_eod, corr_rth_eod, corr_pre_eod, corr_rth_eod, corr_pre_eod, corr_rth_eod)

# --- Event markers: decorrelation episodes in either window ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='ES-CL Decorrelation',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Correlation', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Window', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='ES Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='CL Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(decorr_corr, decorr_window, es_cont.c, cl_cont.c, is_any_decorr)
